rationale: PINS the SCD9 gap (M37 #598): ABSTRACT trait fields parse as val_declaration/var_declaration (type clause, no initializer) while concrete ones parse as val_definition/var_definition. The walk handled only the concrete forms, so every abstract interface field emitted NOTHING — the exact gap already fixed for abstract def (function_declaration). Abstract def, abstract val, abstract var must all be symbols with contains edges; the abstract forms carry isAbstract metadata.
